import re

async def act(page):
    # Set the status filter to 'Pending' to show only pending orders
    # Locate the status combobox in the filter row
    # The filter row is the second row in the first rowgroup of the main table
    filter_row = page.get_by_role('row').filter(has=page.get_by_role('cell', name='Any'))
    status_combobox = filter_row.get_by_role('combobox').last  # Based on tree, the last combobox in that row is for status
    await status_combobox.select_option('Pending')
    
    # Click the Search button to apply the filter
    search_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Search')
    await search_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    
    # Now extract the 'G.T. (Purchased)' values from the first 5 rows after filtering
    # Locate the main table with order rows
    main_table = page.get_by_role('table').nth(3)  # Based on tree, the fourth table contains the order rows
    rows = main_table.get_by_role('row').all()
    
    # Skip the header and filter rows: rows[0] is header, rows[1] is filter row, so data starts from rows[2]
    data_rows = rows[2:] if len(rows) > 2 else []
    
    grand_totals = []
    for row in data_rows[:5]:  # Take first 5 rows (most recent pending orders)
        cells = row.get_by_role('cell').all()
        if len(cells) >= 8:  # 'G.T. (Purchased)' is the 8th cell (0-indexed 7)
            gt_cell = cells[7]
            text = await gt_cell.text_content()
            if text and text.strip():
                # Convert currency string to float
                try:
                    value = float(text.strip().replace('$', '').replace(',', ''))
                    grand_totals.append(value)
                except ValueError:
                    pass
    
    if grand_totals:
        total_amount = sum(grand_totals)
        return str(total_amount)
    else:
        # If no pending orders found, return 0 or handle as needed
        return '0.0'
